audience: Shoprocket store operators with a customer Store Secret Key

useCases.title: Review paid orders awaiting shipment
useCases.text: Find orders by payment and fulfillment status, then inspect line items, customer details and shipping information.

useCases.title: Review store performance
useCases.text: Read sales statistics for a date range and compare them with the preceding period.

useCases.title: Update a requested order status
useCases.text: Inspect an order, then change its requested payment or fulfillment status. Customer email is optional; marking a payment status does not charge a card.

useCases.title: Create a checkout discount code
useCases.text: Review existing codes, then create the requested discount with its dates and usage limit. The code can reduce revenue when shoppers redeem it.
